name: J. Juelfs
bio: J. Juelfs brought his bull-team outfit up from Deadwood in May 1884 to haul freight over the Medora route. In June 1884 it pulled out with 75,000 pounds of freight.

moments.label: Bull outfit left with 75,000 pounds of freight

mentions: J. Juelfs arrived Tuesday from Deadwood. He came on in advance of his outfit, which will probably be in to-day. It is made up of sixteen wagons and one hundred and six oxen.
J. Juelfs is loading his bull teams and will "gee, haw" to-day or to-morrow.
J. Juelf's bull outfit pulled out with 75,000 pounds of freight last Monday morning.
